''"One authentic Jedi holocron and the memory crystal I was after. When my benefactor gets this, he will compensate you for your puny fleet.|[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]|}} The '''Battle of Devaron''' took place on and in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] led a force of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] in a surprise attack on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] homeworld to take the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] hostage. While [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] gave Bane the assigned task of stealing a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], Ropal kept a [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], which contained a list of every known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], essentially the future of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. In the ensuing battle, Ropal was taken hostage by Bane, and the Republic outpost on Devaron was destroyed. As Cad Bane attempted to make a jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] out of the system, a task force led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] in the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] arrived and intercepted Bane's frigate. Since they hadn't brought the necessary [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]] along with them to board his ship, [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] were used as makeshift boarding craft, since they were pressurized and had magnetic feet, a tactic suggested to Yularen by Skywalker. During a botched attempt to force Ropal to activate the holocron, Ropal was accidentally tortured to death. Bane thought of it as only a minor setback to his mission and was determined to get Anakin Skywalker to activate the holocron for him. He manipulated the battle on board his frigate to separate Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from him and used her as bait to lure Skywalker in. Left with no other options that would end in his favor, Anakin was forced to open the holocron for Bane, who then attempted to flee the ship. The ship was set to self-destruct, and as the Jedi task force prepared to leave, Bane confronted two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] while making his escape. To the Republic forces, he appeared to be killed in the ensuing struggle, but in reality, Bane had switched his clothing with the armor of the clone trooper [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] after killing him. Under the guise of Denal, Bane managed to leave the doomed frigate on the same [[Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle (Cad Bane's frigate)/Legends|shuttle]] as the Republic survivors. Upon return to the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], Bane's cover was blown by Ahsoka Tano, and despite attempts by Skywalker and Yularen to block his exit, Bane escaped in a stolen [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] with the active holocron. ==Prelude== Following the success of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] assignment to rescue [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] imprisonment, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] began to rely on Bane for his own personal use. One of these missions was to infiltrate the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and extract a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|library]]. Bane hired [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] to assist him, Parasitti being a valuable asset to the mission with her natural Clawdite shapeshifting abilities. [[File:CadeBaneInvasionForce-ActOnInstinct.png|thumb|left|200px|Cad Bane's invasion force]] In order to complete the holocron, the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] held by [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] would have to be retrieved as well, and following the heist at the Temple, a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] fleet was sent to escort Bane to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], where the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was assisting the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] ministers in making the land more fertile. Since Bane had abandoned Parasitti at the Temple, he brought his occasional partner [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] along to assist him, placing her in command of [[Nashtah Team]]. ==The battle== ===Invasion=== {{Quote|Sir, we've caught them by surprise. Initiating land assault.|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] to Cad Bane|}} [[File:BattleOfDevaron-AoI.png|thumb|right|300px|Bane's forces arrive]] The Separatist fleet under the command of Cad Bane had taken the Republic forces stationed on the planet off guard. While [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] had the opportunity to apprehend Ropal upon landing, Bane ordered her to hold back, as he wanted to capture him himself. In the ensuing crossfire, Nashtah Team destroyed a gunship that was carrying [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]], who had narrowly escaped death by the explosion. Ropal was captured during the battle. ===Space battle=== {{Quote|You are NOT thinking of using those to transport the clones to that frigate.|Admiral Yularen|}} [[File:DroidsOnTheRun-CoD.png|thumb|left|200px|Confused battle droids flee from AT-TEs attached to their frigate's hull]] During Bane's heist in the Temple, the captured Cato Parassiti revealed to the Jedi that Bane's next target would be Ropal on Devaron, so a rescue team led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was sent to retrieve Ropal. However, by the time the rescue team had gotten to Devaron, Bane was already fleeing the battle with Ropal in his Munificent-class frigate. The team was prepared to deploy onto the planet, and therefor didn't bring the necessary boarding craft to conduct a boarding operation. As the Republic fleet opened fire on Bane's frigate, Bane was forced to speed up the interrogation process to get Ropal to activate the holocron. Ropal refused, and was accidentally tortured to death. At General Skywalker's advice, the ship's payload of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|walkers]] were used as makeshift boarding craft, as they were pressurized and had magnetized feet, after bringing down Bane's escort and destroying the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. While [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Wullf Yularen was hesitant, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] liked his idea. Walkers [[773/Legends|773]] and [[ATAT300/Legends|ATAT300]] were activated, manned by [[Carnivore Battalion/Legends|Carnivore Battalion]] and [[Execute Battalion/Legends|Execute Battalion]], respectively, as well as an unidentified third walker. The three walkers were dropped onto the hull of the Separatist frigate, which threw the droids heavily off guard, as they have never seen this tactic before. The Jedi crossed the ships hull and used the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to open an airlock to gain access to the frigate. [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was angered at Bane's disregard for his fleet, which Gunray donated to him at the request of Darth Sidious. Bane assured Gunray he would be compensated for it, most likely by Sidious if Bane succeeded his mission of stealing the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]]. Gunray asked Bane to transmit the information on the holocron to him, but Bane would need a Jedi to open it, and Bane pointed out to Gunray there were two about to board the ship, one more than necessary. Bane ordered for the ship's memory banks to be wiped and its self-destruct sequence to be activated, as well as the ship's functions to be transferred to his [[Wrist link/Legends|wrist link]], before fleeing the bridge in a chute, just before the Jedi and clones stormed the bridge and destroyed its crew. ===Confronting the bounty hunter=== {{Quote|Let's make this a bit more interesting.|Cad Bane|}} After clearing the main bridge, the Jedi found a hologram recording of Bane's conversation with Gunray, which confirmed that he was in possession of the kyber crystal. To prevent Bane from escaping the ship, Rex and his squad destroyed the ship's supply of [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Yularen witnessed an explosion in the ship's aft section, but Anakin still pressed on to find Ropal. The Jedi and clones searched the ship for Ropal, and Ahsoka found his body in a prison cell. Anakin ordered a few clones to bring Ropal's body to the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. They had no other options than to find Bane and retrieve the crystal. Bane had deactivated the ship's lights using his wrist-com, and so the clones were forced to use [[Night vision/Legends|night vision]]. [[File:BaneTorturesAhsoka.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Cad Bane applies a stun charge to Ahsoka.]] Bane was spotted by R2-D2's scanners, and the Jedi pursued. He led them to the ship's gunnery deck, where he reactivated the lights to reveal an army of droids awaiting. The droids opened fire, and in the midst of the firefight, Bane used his wrist-com to deactivate the ship's artificial [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity wells]], turning the ship into a zero gravity environment. The clones were trained for this type of situation, and were equipped with magnetic boots, as were the droids. To make matters worse, the gunnery deck was full of ammunition canisters, which meant stray fire could cause the entire gunnery deck to explode. Bane and Skywalker started a fierce battle. Later on Skywalker kicked Bane in the face, which caused him to float away in a spinning motion, causing the holocron to fall out of Bane's duster. Just as Anakin was about to grab it, R2-D2 reactivated the gravity, sending him, Bane, and the holocron falling to the floor. As Skywalker was dazed, Bane snatched the holocron and fled. Anakin pursued, but Bane distracted him by causing a clone attached to the ceiling with his magnetized boots to fall. While Anakin was distracted saving the clone, Ahsoka gave chase. Bane used his wrist-com to close the blast door, separating Ahsoka from her master. When Anakin attempted to cut through the door, a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] accidentally shot an ammo canister, causing the ceiling to collapse, trapping Anakin in the rubble. As Bane reached a dead end in the hallway, he took a shot at Ahsoka, which she easily deflected back to his left arm. Bane managed to disarm Ahsoka, but she still managed to flip the bounty hunter onto the floor. She thought she had beaten him, but the bounty hunter grabbed her ankle and delivered a massive stun charge through her body, knocking her unconscious. Anakin sensed this, and in his rage broke through the rubble that surrounded him. He then ordered Rex and his squad to return to the hangar bay and find a transport. Anakin activated his comlink and tried to contact Ahsoka, who unfortunately was still out cold. When Anakin received the order from Admiral Yuralen to abandon the mission because the ship was about to explode, he in return ordered Yularen to move the ''Resolute'' a safe distance from the ship and moved on to save his Padawan. Ahsoka was placed in self-tightening [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]]. Bane took her [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]] as a trophy for his success over her, and placed her in between an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] and a [[Force field/Legends|force field]]. With the press of a button on his wrist, the airlock can open, sucking Ahsoka out into the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of space. He further lured Skywalker to them by applying a stun charge to Ahsoka, and Anakin arrived after cutting down three battle droids. Bane promised he would kill Ahsoka if Anakin refused to open the holocron. Left with no other options that were in his favor, Anakin put his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] down and agreed to activate the holocron. ===Escape from the frigate=== Around the same time Rex and his squad found a [[Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle (Cad Bane's frigate)/Legends|shuttle]] in the hangar bay that could be used as their escape from the ship. In the firefight destroying the remaining droids, a fuel leak leading to a group of ammo canisters was lit, and Yularen detected that the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] was going to collapse any minute. Rex ordered soldiers [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and [[Koho/Legends|Koho]] to break off from the main squad and find Anakin. With Bane momentarily distracted by the holocron, Anakin used this opportunity to retrieve both his and Ahsoka's lightsabers and cut down the battle droids flanking Bane. Bane opened the airlock, and Anakin quickly tossed a chunk of a battle droid at the force field controls, deactivating them. The entire airlock vestibule was compromised, and Bane escaped using his [[Rocket boot/Legends|rocket boots]], before the emergency blast door sealed itself shut. Anakin managed to close the airlock and cut Ahsoka out of her stun cuffs. While Anakin wanted to pursue Bane in retaliation, Ahsoka urged him to have patience, and he agreed. Bane reported to Gunray that he was successful in activating the holocron, and assured the Viceroy that he had his own means of escape. He was then confronted by troopers Denal and Koho in the hallway leading to the hangar bay. Bane quickly killed the two clones, and proceeded to switch his clothes with Denal's clone trooper armor. To make it seem like he was dead, Bane took Denal's body, now wearing the bounty hunter's clothes, and shot it off a balcony in clear view of the surviving Republic forces. Bane, under the guise of Denal, regrouped with the other Republic forces at the shuttle, delivering the news that he failed to retrieve the holocron. They fell for his ploy. Just as the shuttle carrying the survivors fled, the fuel leak exploded, and, combined with the explosion in the main reactor, compromised the entire frigate. ===Cad Bane's escape=== Upon arrival at the Star Destroyer, Admiral Yularen was disappointed in the outcome of the battle, crediting the outcome as Anakin's version of success. Bane attempted to leave while everyone else was distracted. However, traces of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]] were found on the floor of the shuttle. Rex pointed out that it did not belong to any of his men. Ahsoka Tano intercepted Bane, and quickly discovered that he wasn't Denal after inspecting the blaster shot on his arm. Bane then proceeded to knee Ahsoka in the stomach and flee to a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] while incapacitating the two clones guarding it-one with his backpack and the other with a punch, prompting Yularen to order all of the hyperspace rings to be locked down. As Bane took off, Skywalker attempted to pull him out of the cockpit, but only managed to knock the bounty hunter's helmet off. The rings weren't locked down in time, and Bane escaped into hyperspace. ==Aftermath== After Bane successfully escaped with the holocron, he retreated to his personal safehouse, [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]]. There, Darth Sidious gave Bane a new assignment: to kidnap four of the children listed in the holocron and bring them to his lab on the volcanic world [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and turn them into [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] by brain washing them to be loyal to Sidious until death. ==Behind the scenes== The torture scene, which was all on screen, was a bit controversial at the time of the episode ''[[Cargo of Doom]]''{{'s}} release. Director [[Dave Filoni]] said that the design team never once considered toning it down, as the scene was depicted as how it should've been depicted. The scene was meant to display the character Cad Bane's ruthlessness. Another point of interest during the scene was the depiction of the battle droids, whose voices are almost monotonous and almost morbid.{{SW|url=video/cargo-of-doom-episode-featurette|text="Cargo of Doom" Episode Featurette}} The script originally called for a group of black painted [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|retail droids]] to haul Bolla Ropal around. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Battle of Devaron}} *{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} {{Flash}} *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] {{1stID|Battle of Devaron}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'' {{1st}} *{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}} *{{TCW|Children of the Force}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]] *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{FactFile2014|11|SKY 23-26|Anakin Skywalker}} *{{SWE|technology|attewalker|AT-TE walker}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Devaron (Cad Bane)#legends |es=Batalla de Devaron |nl=Battle of Devaron |deFA=1 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Devaron, Battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Devaron]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]]
